verdict.rationale: Circle's docs name official SDKs: Web and Mobile SDKs (Android and iOS) for Wallets, and Bridge Kit, a lightweight SDK for CCTP USDC transfers. The CLI page also mentions multiple Circle SDKs. Coverage is uneven, though: other products such as Gateway, StableFX, CPN and Compliance appear only as REST/OpenAPI specs, so SDK support across the platform is not shown. Missing for 10: documented server-side SDK languages and package names, SDK coverage beyond Wallets and CCTP, SDK reference depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You integrate using REST APIs or Web and Mobile SDKs (Android and iOS).
Bridge Kit is a lightweight SDK that uses CCTP as its protocol provider, letting you transfer USDC between blockchains in just a few lines of code.
